project: Docs agents, factory overview, and reference consolidation
description: Implement approved docs consolidation: add `you docs agents`, ship `factory/docs/overview.md` with portable bundle registration, deduplicate batch docs under `batch-inputs`, move factory.json topology to `you docs config` and submitted work to `you docs work`, and index agent guidance in `docs/README.md` with a slim `factory/README.md`.

context.customerAsk: Implement the approved PRD for you docs agents, factory/docs overview, and reference consolidation: packaged agents topic, factory/docs/overview.md, single batch guide (batch-inputs with batch-work alias), config owns factory.json topology and work owns submitted work only, docs/README.md agent index, slim factory/README.md pointer.
context.problem: Agent orientation is fragmented across factory/README.md, duplicate batch-work and batch-inputs guides, and work.md mixing factory.json topology with submitted-work contracts. Checked-in factories lack a standard factory/docs/ overview for instance-specific guidance.
context.solution: Register you docs agents as the primary agent topic, author factory/docs/overview.md for this factory with export registration when required, maintain one batch-inputs markdown with batch-work as alias, expand config and slim work, put repo-level agent conventions in docs/README.md, and reduce factory/README.md to pointers—without runtime or API changes.

acceptanceCriteria: Running `you docs agents` prints a self-contained agent orientation guide and lists the topic on bare `you docs`.
Running `you docs config` owns factory.json topology; running `you docs work` owns submitted-work contracts only.
Running `you docs batch-work` and `you docs batch-inputs` returns byte-identical markdown from a single source file.
`factory/docs/overview.md` exists with this factory's pipeline, work types, inboxes, and maintainer notes; portable export includes it when required.
`docs/README.md` indexes agents and factory/docs conventions; `factory/README.md` points to overview and `you docs agents` without duplicating walkthrough.
Packaged copies under `pkg/cli/docs/reference/` stay synced with `docs/reference/` per packaged CLI docs policy.
Quality gate: typecheck, lint, and tests pass for all touched packages.

userStories.title: Single maintained batch guide
userStories.description: As a factory author using the CLI, I want one batch reference so `you docs batch-work` and `you docs batch-inputs` never disagree.
acceptanceCriteria: `docs/reference/batch-inputs.md` opens with the former batch-work quick-reference summary followed by the full FACTORY_REQUEST_BATCH contract
Standalone `batch-work.md` is removed; `docs.go` resolves alias `batch-work` to the same path as `batch-inputs`
Running `you docs batch-work` and `you docs batch-inputs` prints identical markdown
Pre-submit guidance in the batch guide directs readers to target `factory.json` and, when present, `factory/docs/overview.md` or `factory/docs/README.md`
`docs/internal/processes/development-guide-relevant-files.md` documents `batch-inputs` as the single maintained owner and `batch-work` as alias-only
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Split config and work ownership
userStories.description: As a reader of packaged docs, I want `you docs config` to own factory layout and `you docs work` to own submitted work only.
acceptanceCriteria: Running `you docs config` includes work-type and state tables, top-level factory.json field narrative, portability and supportingFiles routing context, and topology summaries moved from work

Running `you docs work` covers submitted work only: POST /work, batch cross-links, tags to templates, token flow, and submission-oriented how-pieces-fit—without topology field tables now owned by config
`docs/reference/README.md` and `docs/README.md` state config owns factory.json topology and work owns submitted work
Inbound links in authoring-factories, relationships, guards, batch-inputs, and resources point to config for topology and work for submission where appropriate
CLI smoke tests for `you docs work` and `you docs config` assert topology markers on config and submitted-work markers on work
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: `you docs agents` packaged topic
userStories.description: As an autonomous agent, I want one CLI topic that explains how to use you across factories, work submission, and topic routing.
acceptanceCriteria: `docs/reference/agents.md` is authored and synced to `pkg/cli/docs/reference/agents.md`
`you docs agents` is registered in `docs.go`, appears on bare `you docs`, and is listed in unsupported-topic supported-topic errors

The agents guide covers start here, read order, authoring pointers, submitting work, command matrix, planner vs executor vs authoring-agents-md, topic router, and factory/docs discovery without infinite-you-specific work type names in normative sections
`pkg/cli/docs/docs_test.go` and `tests/functional/smoke/cli_docs_smoke_test.go` cover `you docs agents` with representative content markers
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
